label: 黑暗精灵 attack
subject: A pale-skinned underground elven archer, pointed ear, short black hood, dark leather armor and ragged charcoal cloak, carrying a compact recurved wooden bow and quiver. Restrained dark gray and muted purple, alert low standing stance. Both feet grounded, bow held ready, no released arrow.
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Animate the EXACT project character in input1. Preserve head/face, proportions, materials, palette, clothing, armor and accessories. Four poses:1 bow held at rest;2 raise bow to aim RIGHT while drawing string halfway;3 full draw string toward cheek, bow arm extended RIGHT;4 release string with pulling hand moving back, empty bow after shot. One identical bow, same fingers/arms and quiver, correct string connection. No floating released arrow or trail drawn inside character frames.
Layout: EXACTLY FOUR frames in a2by2equal-cell grid, reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each cell logically64x64pixels, with2logicalpixels of completely clear margin on every side. Fixed side-three-quarter camera facing RIGHT. Every cell has SAME scale, body size, foot ground line and lighting as reference. Frame1 has the original neutral body size for reference. Do not shrink the character to make extended poses fit: draw compact poses instead.
Strong low-resolution pixel clusters, exactly the same limited RGB color palette as reference, upper-left light, dark outline, no dithering or smooth painting. Genuine transparent RGBA, binary alpha. No frame lines, text, labels, names, scene, separate object, ground shadow, aura, slash, dust or particle effects. Whole character/weapon fits inside every frame. No cut-off limbs or detached limbs.
